name: Anna Kalinskaya
intro: Anna Kalinskaya grew up in Moscow and now trains in Miami. She plays smart, tricky tennis full of surprises. Her tiny dog Bella is her biggest fan.
story: Anna started tennis at age five after watching her cousin play. Both her parents were pro badminton players! This year she reached her first French Open quarterfinal. On Friday she beat the No. 9 seed in three sets. A seed is a top-ranked player, so that was a big win.

funFacts.text: Her dog Bella is a cream-colored dachshund. Bella travels to tournaments with her.
Bella once ran onto the court after a win to get pets. Bella even got her own badge!
Her mom and dad were both pro badminton players.
Her brother Nikolay is a pro soccer player.
She loves cooking, shopping, and watching basketball in her free time.
She started tennis at five after watching her cousin play at Grandma's house.
She won the Australian Open girls' doubles title in 2016.

watchFor: Watch for her drop shot, a sneaky soft ball that barely hops the net!
